# Spreadsheet import

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs` from src/lib/nnr-sheet.ts and src/lib/import/mapping.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

Supervisors import the existing monitoring spreadsheet at **Import** (`/admin/import`), as `.xlsx` or `.csv`.
Two layouts are recognised automatically:

1. **NNR's monitoring sheet** (3 header rows, columns A–X below). The app's own raw Excel export uses
   the same layout, plus app columns after a blank column, so an export can be re-imported.
2. **The one-row template** (`docs/import-template.xlsx`, headers further down).

## How it works

1. Upload with **Check only** ticked: nothing is saved; you see how many rows are valid and every problem.
2. Untick it and import: valid rows become shipments (source `IMPORT`), invalid rows are listed with the reason.
3. Download **rows to fix** (same layout as your upload, with `ERROR` and `ORIGINAL ROW` columns at the end),
   correct them and upload that file. Rows already imported are skipped (same HBL No., Job No. or old
   booking no.; rows without any number by shipper + destination + pick-up + cargo), so re-uploading is safe.

## Options

- **History cut-off** (default: 30 days ago). Rows whose booking date (ATD, else ETD, else pick-up) is before it are imported as
  **Closed history**: kept for search and volume reports, but no alerts and no on-time scoring
  (the old sheet doesn't record when FSI or pre-advise were actually done). Leave empty to import every row as live.
- **Start year.** The sheet's dates have no year (`04-Apr`). Rows are in booking order, so each date takes the
  year nearest to the row before it. The first row's year is guessed so that no date ends up more than
  120 days in the future; set it yourself if the guess is wrong (the check shows the year used).
- **Merge similar shipper names** (on by default): see the shipper column below.
- **Add shippers**: create shippers not in the app yet.

## NNR monitoring sheet columns

| Col | Header | How it is read |
|---|---|---|
| A | HBL NO. | Kept as the HBL No. `DIRECT BL` = no HBL (shipping line's own BL). `NNRMNL…F7003 / PART OF 7002` = split shipment, linked to HBL 7002. |
| B | BOOKING NO. | Shipping line booking no. |
| C | SHIPPER | Matched ignoring spaces and punctuation; spellings one typo apart are merged into the most used one (listed after the check). |
| D | DESTINATION | Required. The 3-letter HBL code comes from the HBL No., else from the city name. |
| E | ETD MNL | Date |
| F | ATD MNL | Date (makes the shipment DEPARTED) |
| G | ETA POD | Date |
| H | ATA POD | Date (makes it ARRIVED) |
| I | FCL / 40FT | `1X40'HC & 1X40ST`, `2X40`… |
| J | 20FT | `2X20`… |
| K | LCL / Quantity | `3 PALLETS`, `27 CTS`, `1 WOODEN BOX`… (FCL and LCL on one row is an error) |
| L | SHIPPER'S REQUESTED PICK UP DATE | Date; `TBA` = not set yet |
| M | ACTUAL PICK UP DATE | Date |
| N | CUT OFF DATE & TIME / FSI | Date & time, e.g. `11 OCT @ 1200H` |
| O | PRE ADVISE | Date & time |
| P | ARRASTRE | Date & time; `N/A` = shipper pays arrastre |
| Q | EXPORT DECLARTION / C/O SHIPPER | Filled (not `N/A`) = declaration c/o shipper; a date = filed on that date. |
| R | C/O NNR | A date = filed on that date. `C/O NNR (AAI)` = pending, filed by NNR through forwarder AAI. |
| S | DATE UPLOAD TO BOC PORTAL | Date; `c/o shipper` is kept in remarks |
| T | DATE ARRASTE PAID | Date; `N/A` here or in the arrastre cut-off = shipper pays |
| U | DATE SENT THE EXPORT DOCUMENTS / TO CUSTOMER | Date sent to customer |
| V | TO OVERSEAS OFFICE | Date sent to the overseas office |
| W | CARRIER / SHIPPING LINE / CO-LOADER | Shipping line or co-loader name |
| X | REMARKS | Kept. `CANCELLED` in remarks = cancelled shipment. |

App columns after the blank column (in the app's export): `JOB NO.`, `STATUS`, `ASSIGNED CS`, `CS EMAIL`, `CONSIGNEE`, `POD`, `FSI SUBMITTED`, `PRE-ADVISE SENT`, `DECLARATION STATUS`, `BOC UPLOAD DEADLINE`.
`CS EMAIL` (or `ASSIGNED CS`) sets the assigned CS; otherwise it is the person importing.

Dates are read as Asia/Manila time. Accepted: `04-Apr`, `11 OCT @ 1200H`, `15-16 MAY` (first day),
real Excel dates. `TBA`, `N/A`, `-` are blank. Slash dates like `10/11` are rejected (day/month order is ambiguous).

## One-row template

The first row must use the headers below (any one spelling per field; case, spaces and punctuation are ignored).


| Field | Accepted headers | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| jobNo | `Job No.`, `Job No`, `Booking No.`, `Booking No`, `Booking No. (manual)` |  | Kept if it is a valid EX-O-YYMM-#### number not already used; otherwise a new Job No. is issued and the old one is kept on the timeline. |
| hblNo | `HBL No.`, `HBL No`, `HBL` |  | Kept as is (already given to customers). `NNRMNLNGOF8687 / PART OF 8665` links a split shipment. Blank: a new HBL No. is issued. |
| shipper | `Shipper` | yes | Matched to the shipper list ignoring punctuation and Inc/Corp/Co. Unknown shippers are created (option) or reported. |
| consignee | `Consignee` |  |  |
| destination | `Destination`, `Destination Port` | yes |  |
| pod | `POD`, `Port of Discharge` |  | Blank: same as Destination. |
| cargo | `Cargo`, `Containers`, `Container`, `Volume` | yes | FCL like `2x40HC + 1x20` (40HQ/40'HC/40GP accepted); LCL like `LCL 6 PALLET`, `6 plts`, `30 ctns`. |
| carrier | `Carrier`, `Shipping Line` |  |  |
| bookingRef | `Carrier Booking Ref`, `Carrier Booking No.`, `Booking Ref` |  |  |
| requestedPickup | `Requested Pick-up`, `Requested Pickup`, `Pick-up Date`, `Pickup Date` |  |  |
| actualPickup | `Actual Pick-up`, `Actual Pickup` |  |  |
| fsiCutoff | `FSI Cut-off`, `FSI Cutoff` |  |  |
| fsiSubmitted | `FSI Submitted` |  |  |
| preadviseCutoff | `Pre-advise Cut-off`, `Preadvise Cut-off`, `Pre-advise Cutoff` |  |  |
| preadviseSent | `Pre-advise Sent`, `Preadvise Sent` |  |  |
| arrastreCutoff | `Arrastre Cut-off`, `Arrastre Cutoff` |  |  |
| declaration | `Export Declaration`, `Export Decl.`, `Declaration` |  | PENDING, FILED, ASSESSED or RELEASED. Blank: PENDING. |
| bocUploaded | `BOC Uploaded`, `BOC Upload` |  |  |
| arrastreBy | `Arrastre By`, `Arrastre` |  | NNR or SHIPPER. Blank: the shipper's default. |
| arrastrePaid | `Arrastre Paid` |  |  |
| docsSent | `Export Docs Sent`, `Docs Sent` |  |  |
| etd | `ETD MNL`, `ETD` |  |  |
| atd | `ATD MNL`, `ATD` |  |  |
| eta | `ETA` |  |  |
| ata | `ATA` |  |  |
| status | `Status` |  | Only `Cancelled` and `Closed` are used; every other status is recalculated from the dates. |
| cs | `Assigned CS`, `CS` |  | User name or email of an active CS/supervisor. Blank: the person importing. |
| remarks | `Carrier Remarks`, `Remarks` |  |  |

Ignored on purpose (calculated by the app): `BOC Upload Deadline`, `Arrastre Deadline`.

## Values

- **Dates:** real Excel date cells, or text `16-Oct-2026 09:00` / `2026-10-16 09:00`, read as Asia/Manila time.
  Slash dates such as `10/11/2026` are rejected because day/month order is ambiguous.
- **Shipment date for reports:** the earliest of requested pick-up, FSI cut-off and ETD, so old shipments
  count in their own month. New Job Nos. use that month too.
- **Status** is recalculated from the dates (e.g. an ATD makes it DEPARTED); only "Cancelled" and "Closed" are read.
- **Arrastre Paid** on imported rows needs no proof file (old records); new payments in the app still require proof.
- Every row is checked with the same rules as the shipment form (e.g. ETA after ETD, FCL needs containers),
  plus: ATA needs ATD, arrastre cannot be paid by NNR when the shipper pays.
- Max 5000 rows per file.
